name: Garments
overview: Scripture reveals that garments hold significant spiritual and practical meaning, as seen when God clothed Adam and Eve with coats of skins after the Fall, symbolizing divine provision and covering (Genesis 3:21). The holy garments made for Aaron were crafted for glory and beauty, emphasizing the sacred role of clothing in worship and service (Exodus 28:2). Additionally, the detailed instructions regarding garments affected by leprosy underscore the importance of purity and holiness in daily life, requiring careful examination and separation to maintain ceremonial cleanliness (Leviticus 13:47-50). Thus, garments in the Bible convey themes of provision, sanctity, and the visible expression of spiritual realities.
